strings.دروس تشطيب البيت في الكويت 8: راجع الأسط: Home finishing lessons in Kuwait 8: inspect surfaces and waterproofing before covering
strings.الخامة النهائية تبين للعين، لكن حالة الس: The final finish is visible, but the substrate and details in water-exposed areas deserve equal attention. Lesson eight in the Almusaileem series helps you prepare questions for specialist review of surfaces and waterproofing, so finishing starts with clear information, particularly in bathrooms and areas requiring moisture-specific treatment.

strings.شنو تحتاج قبل المراجعة؟: What do you need before the review?
strings.جهز مخطط المنطقة، الخامات المقترحة، نتائ: Prepare the area plan, proposed materials, the results of the extension inspection, and photographs of any previous moisture or damage. The required output is a surface acceptance record, insulation system data where necessary, and documentation of the inspection before coverage. Some of these steps may interfere with foundation or flooring work; the specialist determines their arrangement according to the system and site conditions.
strings.ابدأ بسبب المشكلة في البيت القائم: Start with the problem in the house.
strings.إذا شفت بقعة رطوبة أو تقشرًا أو تلفًا مت: If there is a spot of moisture, peeling or repeated damage, record its location and the circumstances of its appearance and ask the appropriate specialist to evaluate the cause. The disappearance of the trail after cleaning it is not sufficient evidence that the cause has ended. Agree on the treatment officer and do not prove the readiness of the area before the finishing team returns.
strings.متى تغيّر تشطيب الحمام ومتى تفحص المشكلة: When to change the bathroom finish and when to check the problem first?
strings.في ترتيب أسئلتك. في هذا الدرس نضيف خطوة: In the order of your questions. In this lesson we add the step of documenting the decision: what problem has been identified, what treatment is required, and who to review the result. Avoid adopting a new cladding just because it hides the effect from consideration.
strings.اسأل عن قبول السطح للخامة المحددة: Ask about surface acceptance of the selected tent
strings.اطلب من المنفّذ توضيح شروط السطح التي يح: Ask the outlet to explain the surface conditions that the selected product needs: condition, humidity, cleanliness, stability, and any moisture or processing requirements. Keep the evaluation and measurements required by the specialist, according to the system data. Do not transfer a condition from one product to another, and do not adopt a general waiting period just because it was appropriate in a different project.
The importance of a suitable surface that is compatible with the system. This is an example of why you need specific product instructions, not automatic filtering for it per house. Record any necessary surface treatment and who will implement it and who will receive it before moving to the next layer.
strings.راجع العزل كنظام متكامل: See insulation as an integrated system
strings.اسأل المختص عن حدود المنطقة التي تحتاج ع: Ask the specialist about the boundaries of the area that needs to be isolated, the chosen system and the compatibility of its components. Ask for clarification of the treatment of the confluence between the floor and the wall, angles, the perimeter of the service openings, and the connection of insulation to drainage, depending on the design and factory instructions. The selection and application of these details is the responsibility of the insulation specialist and supervision concerned with the project.
strings.شلوتر في دليل عزل مناطق الدش: Schlutter in the guide to the isolation of shower areas
strings.أن البلاط والروبة لا يشكلان وحدهما نظامً: Tiles and soil alone are not a waterproofing system. Therefore, do not make the beauty of tiles or the cleanliness of spacers a substitute for asking what is below. Also check the settings and direction of water drainage with the specialist, and their relationship to the door and the adjacent floor before installing the final details.
strings.وثق الفحص قبل تغطية العزل: Document the inspection before covering the insulation
strings.اتفق على الفحص المناسب وتوقيته ومسؤوله ق: Agree on proper, timely and responsible inspection before installing finishing. Remember
strings.أن الاختبار يأتي قبل تركيب البلاط للتحقق: That the test comes before the installation of tiles to verify the implementation. The type, duration and conditions of the test are determined for the actual system by the specialist; do not perform the immersion test yourself or use numbers from another system.
strings.احتفظ ببيانات المواد، وصور التفاصيل قبل: Keep the material data, and photos of details before covering it, the result of the examination and any processing and re-checking. After that, it was agreed to protect the insulation from damage during the entry of the following teams, and to consult the specialist if the work requires a hole or modification.
